description: This Java class 'TaskEvents' handles order processing task events such as completing assignments, accepting role assignments, and delegating assignments within the Apache OFBiz framework. It interacts with services, event handlers, and request/response objects to manage order-related workflows.

classes.name: TaskEvents
classes.description: Handles order processing task events such as completing assignments, accepting role assignments, and delegating assignments within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: completeAssignment
methods.description: Completes an assignment by invoking the 'wfCompleteAssignment' service with parameters extracted from the HTTP request.

methods.name: acceptRoleAssignment
methods.description: Handles acceptance of a role assignment by invoking the 'wfAcceptRoleAssignment' service via an event handler.

methods.name: delegateAndAcceptAssignment
methods.description: Delegates and accepts an assignment by invoking the 'wfAcceptRoleAssignment' service via an event handler.

methods.name: addToOrderRole
methods.description: Adds a user to an order role by calling the 'addOrderRole' service and handling errors.
